assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: For my project,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 为了我的项目，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: I looked at some unusual sports that people play around the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 我研究了一些世界各地人们玩的不寻常运动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: I'd like to start by talking about chess boxing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 我想先讲讲国际象棋拳击。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: You may already know about the two sports.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 你可能已经了解这两种运动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: Chess is a game played with a board and different chess pieces.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 国际象棋是一种在棋盘上用不同棋子进行的游戏。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: Very intelligent people often play this game because players need to think very carefully.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 非常聪明的人经常玩这种游戏，因为玩家需要非常仔细地思考。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: Boxing is a totally different kind of sport though.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 不过拳击是一种完全不同的运动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: Being strong is more important because boxers have to hit each other.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 强壮更重要，因为拳击手必须互相击打。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: They wear gloves and helmets in the ring, but it's still difficult.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 他们在拳击台上戴着拳套和头盔，但这仍然很困难。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: Now,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 现在，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: chess boxing is a new type of sport where the players do both activities.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 国际象棋拳击是一种新型运动，选手要同时进行这两项活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: They start with boxing,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 他们先进行拳击，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: sorry,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 抱歉，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: I mean chess,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 我是说先下国际象棋，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: and then do some boxing,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 然后再打几回合拳，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: and they continue doing each activity back and forth, alternating.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 再交替轮流进行两项活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: The person who wins the boxing match or the chess game first is the champion.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 最先赢得拳击比赛或国际象棋比赛的人就是冠军。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: One benefit of this sport is that it gives people a chance to compete physically and mentally.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 这项运动的一个好处是，它让人有机会在体力和脑力上竞争。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: It isn't just thinking or physical activity.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 它不只是脑力活动或身体活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.text: It's both.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79e9a5e36766d45.zh: 而是两者兼有。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: Another sport that challenges people is urban golf.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 另一项挑战人们的运动是城市高尔夫。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: Urban golf is similar to normal golf,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 城市高尔夫和普通高尔夫相似，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: but you don't need to go to a golf course.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 但你不必去高尔夫球场。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: You get clubs and a golf ball.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 你拿着球杆和一个高尔夫球。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: it's a soft tennis ball instead of a hard golf ball.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 用的是软网球，而不是硬高尔夫球。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: Then you can play in the street,
which is why it's called urban.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 这就是它被称为“城市”高尔夫的原因。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: you don't need to go anywhere special or need much money to play.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 不必去什么特别的地方，也不需要很多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: You just agree where you want to hit the ball.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 你只要约定把球打向哪里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: at a sign in the street or a rubbish bin.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 比如街上的标志牌或垃圾桶。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: intelligent players know that you may break something if you hit the ball too hard,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 聪明的玩家知道球打得太重可能会弄坏东西，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.text: so they try to play fairly carefully.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5d7626ad120ffce.zh: 所以他们会尽量小心地玩。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.text: I'd like to talk about the Moroccan desert footrace, which is also called the Marathon des Sables or the Tahara Marathon.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.zh: 我想谈谈摩洛哥沙漠越野赛，也叫撒哈拉沙漠马拉松或塔哈拉马拉松。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.text: This race is held every year over a week or rather over six days.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.zh: 这项比赛每年举行一次，持续一周——或者更准确地说，是六天。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.text: The runners have to be really strong.
the runners have to run 92 kilometers.
The best thing about it is that the champion can say he or she has won the hardest marathon in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_371030325b748fd.zh: 最棒的是，冠军可以说自己赢得了世界上最艰难的马拉松。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: I'd like to look at Sepak Takraw.
This is a type of volleyball and is very popular in Southeast Asia.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.zh: 这是一种排球运动，在东南亚很受欢迎。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: The players use a different kind of ball, and they can use their feet to kick the ball or hit it with their knees, chest or head.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.zh: 运动员使用一种不同的球，可以用脚踢球，也可以用膝盖、胸部或头部击球。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: The sport began in Indonesia and it, no,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.zh: 这项运动起源于印度尼西亚，呃不，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: although it is also very popular in Thailand and Indonesia.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.zh: 尽管它在泰国和印度尼西亚也很受欢迎。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: One good thing about Sepak Takraw is that it is now played in schools in many countries, including Japan,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.zh: 藤球的一个优点是，现在包括日本在内的许多国家的学校都开展这项运动，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0a9e1c88a6f9aff.text: and gets children to play sport.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Andre, I know you played in a university football team in the US,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 安德烈，我知道你曾在美国大学足球队踢球，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: so I'd like to ask your opinion about something.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 所以我想问问你对一件事的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Do you think the Olympic athletes and other athletes, like football and tennis players,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 你觉得奥运选手和其他运动员，比如足球和网球选手，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: are too focused on getting money from companies?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 是不是太专注于从公司那里赚钱了？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: I went on holiday in
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 我去度假时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: and every time I turned on the TV,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 每次打开电视，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: I saw a famous athlete in an advert for some product.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 都会看到一位著名运动员为某种产品做广告。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Those athletes are getting paid a huge amount of money to be in adverts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 那些运动员拍广告能拿到巨额报酬。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: It seems like the athletes are more interested in making money than in representing their countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 看起来运动员对赚钱比代表国家更感兴趣。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: I think there is definitely more marketing and business in sport than ever before.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 我觉得体育中的营销和商业活动确实比以前多得多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: As a long -time
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 作为一名长期的

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: I really think all this money and advertising from big companies is taking something away from sports and competitions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 我真的觉得，大公司的这些钱和广告削弱了体育和比赛的某些东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Well, I would say that all athletes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 我想说，所有运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: even the rich and famous ones, are still very focused on the sport.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 即使是富有又出名的，仍然非常专注于运动本身。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Without the sport,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 没有运动，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: they have
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 他们就没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: no
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: job.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: And athletes who aren't famous, or are only a little famous,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 而那些不出名或只有一点名气的运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: deserve to make all the money they can.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 也应该尽量赚到能赚的钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Many athletes devote their whole lives to training.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 许多运动员把一生都投入训练。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: How can they live, work, and pay for coaching all by themselves?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 他们怎么能独自生活、工作并支付教练费用呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Being an athlete,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 当运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: especially one who doesn't get paid,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 尤其是不拿报酬的运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: is extremely expensive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 成本非常高。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: The cost of training is really high,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 训练费用真的很高，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: and athletes need to spend a lot of time training to be good at a sport.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 而且运动员要想擅长某项运动，得花很多时间训练。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: So big companies might give money to sports teams and individual athletes to help them train.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 所以大公司可能会给运动队和个人运动员资助，帮助他们训练。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: In some competitions,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 在一些比赛中，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: like the Olympics,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 比如奥运会，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: there are both professional players and amateurs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 既有职业运动员，也有业余运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: you know, people who do the sport as a hobby and not as a job.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 也就是把运动当作爱好而不是职业的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: I think both should be able to get support from companies.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 我觉得两者都应该能得到公司的支持。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Look at Maria Sakary.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 看看玛丽亚·萨卡里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: She's a Greek tennis player who is paid money by a clothing company to wear their clothes and be in their adverts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 她是一位希腊网球选手，一家服装公司付钱让她穿他们的衣服并拍广告。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Other companies support her too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 其他公司也支持她。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Without all the help from companies,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 如果没有公司的帮助，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: she might not have enough money to play tennis as her job.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 她可能没有足够的钱把打网球当作职业。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.text: Having that time and money allows her to be such a good tennis player.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0acdc1273a3aa09.zh: 拥有这些时间和资金，才让她能成为这么优秀的网球选手。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: But when a big company pays a team or an athlete,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 但当大公司付钱给一支队伍或一名运动员时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: it makes them wear the company name and designs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 就会让他们穿带有公司名称和图案的服装，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: and they sign contracts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 还要签合同。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Isn't that really like being an employee and working for a company?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 这不就很像做公司雇员、为公司工作吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: To me, these athletes work in advertising and marketing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 在我看来，这些运动员是在做广告和营销工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: You have a point,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 你说得有道理，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: but if the athletes don't get good coaching,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 但如果运动员得不到好的指导，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: they might not score a lot of points and do well in competitions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 他们可能无法得很多分，也不能在比赛中表现出色。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: If that happens,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 如果发生这种情况，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: they can lose their chance to make a lot of money after the competitions are over.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 比赛结束后，他们可能会失去赚很多钱的机会。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: And actually,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 而且实际上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: only about five % of Olympic athletes get money from companies to be in adverts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 只有约5%的奥运运动员能从公司获得广告报酬。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: That doesn't sound fair.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 这听起来不公平。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Shouldn't countries pay their own athletes a salary to train?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 难道各国不该给本国运动员发工资训练吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: After all, they do represent the countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 毕竟，他们代表的是国家。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: I read that in the UK, the government pays the country's Olympic athletes to train,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 我读到，在英国，政府付钱让本国奥运运动员训练，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: so there is less pressure there to get money from a company.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 所以他们从公司赚钱的压力较小。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Also,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: there are prizes for all the competitions, and sometimes that gives them extra money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 各种比赛也有奖金，有时这会给他们额外收入。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: a lot of countries can't pay the costs for training athletes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 很多国家支付不起训练运动员的费用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: And of course,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 当然，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: the countries with lots of money can train their athletes very well.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 有很多钱的国家能很好地训练运动员。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: If companies are supporting lots of athletes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 如果公司支持很多运动员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: more people can participate in competitions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 就会有更多人能参加比赛。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Still, I think all this money takes something away from the Olympics and other sporting events.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 不过，我仍觉得这些钱削弱了奥运会和其他体育赛事的一些东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: We see adverts almost everywhere.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 我们几乎到处都能看到广告。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: But being in an advert is a great opportunity for the athlete and the business.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 但拍广告对运动员和企业都是很好的机会。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: If an athlete lets his or her face be on a cereal box or wears some clothing with a company's name on it, people will probably buy the product.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 如果一名运动员让自己的脸出现在麦片盒上，或穿印有公司名称的衣服，人们很可能会购买产品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: So it's good for the company,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 所以这对公司有好处，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: and the athlete gets more money to train.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 运动员也能得到更多训练资金。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: I also think that all the adverts at big competitions like the Olympics or the World Cup help lower the ticket prices for fans,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 我还认为，奥运会或世界杯等大型赛事上的所有广告有助于降低球迷的票价，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: so the competitions don't have to charge so much.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 这样比赛就不必收那么多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: It's good for everyone.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 这对每个人都有好处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: Hmm,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.text: I'm not sure if I agree with you, but I understand your point.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_21f823e57d5da90.zh: 我不确定是否同意你，不过我明白你的意思。
